verdict.rationale: Otter's own materials name an 'Otter API & Webhooks' on the pricing page and a 'Public API' that lets meeting data connect to any system and feed internal knowledge bases. A first-party MCP server with OAuth also exposes transcripts and action items to AI tools. These are only marketing-level mentions, with no reference docs, no endpoint detail for summaries or action items, and no sign that keys are self-serve rather than gated by plan or sales. Missing for 10: published API reference documentation, explicit endpoints for pulling transcripts, summaries, and action items, evidence of self-serve API key issuance, and hands-on or independent corroboration of scripted access.
